map.贷款价值比(LTV)计算器，输入贷款额与抵押物评估值求 LTV，用于按揭与抵押授: Loan-to-value (LTV) calculator: enter loan amount and appraised collateral value to get LTV, for mortgage and secured credit risk assessment.
map.LTV=贷款额÷抵押物评估值。分母通常取评估值与成交价的较低者以防「高评高贷」，: LTV = loan amount ÷ appraised collateral value. The denominator usually takes the lower of appraised value and transaction price to prevent 'inflated appraisal, inflated loan'; the lower the LTV the safer the leverage and the better the buffer against negative equity when prices fall.

map.：LTV=贷款额÷抵押物价值=200÷300=66.7%。低于多数住宅 70%: : LTV = loan ÷ collateral value = 200 ÷ 300 = 66.7%. Below the 70% ceiling most lenders use for a first home, so there is still room in the borrowable amount.

map.对银行是风险越低越好；对借款人 LTV 越低意味着首付越多、杠杆越小。高 LTV: For the bank, lower risk is always better; for the borrower, lower LTV means a bigger down payment and less leverage. High LTV means more leverage but weaker resistance to price drops, so falling prices easily create 'negative equity'.
map.评估值和成交价哪个作分母？: Which is the denominator, appraised value or transaction price?
map.银行通常用「评估值」而非成交价（取较低者），以防范高评高贷。评估值低于成交价时: Banks usually use the 'appraised value' rather than the transaction price (taking the lower of the two) to guard against inflated appraisal and inflated lending. When the appraised value is below the transaction price, LTV comes out higher.
